northStar: Q = 1000 is a stress test of this ledger, not an output of the current stack.

definitions.name: Scientific gain
definitions.meaning: Fusion energy out / energy delivered to the target or plasma
definitions.current: NIF 4.13 (8.6 MJ / 2.08 MJ, Apr 2025). JET peak ≈ 0.67. No MCF Q_sci > 1.

definitions.name: Fuel gain
definitions.meaning: Fusion energy / energy in the fuel assembly
definitions.current: SPARC design Q_fuel of order 2–11. ITER design Q = 10.

definitions.name: Engineering / plant gain
definitions.current: Unshown on any public machine. Harder than Q_sci.

terms.name: Fusion power
terms.note: DT or advanced-fuel yield after hole-burning.

terms.name: Coherence / pumping power
terms.note: Optical pumping against Lindblad collapse. If P_coh / P_fusion ≥ 0.1 at useful n, L1 fails.

terms.name: Spectral refill
terms.note: Power to refill the depleted velocity class. Infinite Maxwellian refill is forbidden.

terms.name: Floquet / laser / RF drive
terms.note: Must count the field that produces 10^15 V/m-class E or 10^27 W/cm^2-class I.

terms.name: Radiation
terms.note: Bremsstrahlung ~ Z^2. High-Z fuels (p-11B) radiate massively. Cavity suppression is a loss-reduction term, not a source.

terms.name: Conversion efficiency
terms.note: Direct conversion is not 100%. Ideal adiabatic extraction is void.

layer2.prc109: DT @ 1 keV: E ~ 1e15–1e16 V/m, ħω ≲ 1 keV
layer2.kill: After hole-burning + SRS/SBS, net <2× thermal at reachable I,ω → Layer 2 off the plant path
